experiment: E1 paired fine-tuning: MixUp overlap versus same-epoch control
checkpoint_selection: best.pt selected by original val fitness; no test-set selection
hypothesis: Learning from overlapping training images may improve hidden-item recognition, particularly Lighter. MixUp is not a physical X-ray simulation or a substitute for real hidden examples.
caveats: Same seed, initialization, data and optimizer in both arms; only MixUp probability differs. Extra draws change later RNG consumption. close_mosaic disables MixUp too, so treatment runs for first 15 epochs. Existing PIDray tests are exploratory; no independent holdout claim. All 12 classes and E2 rates must be evaluated.
